sketchMechanisms: An interface with a method that returns itself but is never implemented — the abstract method declaration without a body means the promise is declared but permanently unfulfilled.
A sealed trait with no extending cases makes pattern matching impossible — the compiler knows there are no inhabitants of the type, so you can never construct or match on it.
A receive block with no matching clause and an `after 0` timeout — the process waits for a message that matches, finds nothing in the mailbox, and immediately times out.
